items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: But Joe Comfort had an electric bass, I remember that.

ctx.x: I had to go through one of the lowest band leaders in the world, Lionel Hampton, where everybody in

America loved him, because he was a showman, jump and down, on his drums. He didn't care about his playing too much. He came in and asked me to join the band. Joe Comfort left to go to Lionel Hampton -- Joe Comfort left to go with Nat King Cole. And he asked me to That's when he joined the band.

And I said, "How much money you pay you?" He said, "How much what you want?" I said, I want $400 a week." And he says, "That's fine, I'll pay you that." This is in California where he was playing a theater there. So I joined the band. I worked locally, like San Francisco and places like that, he paid me this money.
